children: Netflix stock traded near $68, about half its June 2025 record of $134, after co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the streamer is growing more slowly than he wants. According to BeInCrypto, Sarandos blamed part of the slowdown on Netflix’s own spending choices, including live programming, which uses about 5% of its $20 billion annual content budget but generates only around 1% of viewing hours. Investors remain split, with some citing competition from Apple, Amazon and Alphabet.

title: Netflix Stock Nears $68 As Sarandos Flags Slower Growth
